name: MSEarth-Benchmark-MCQ
description: MSEarth-Benchmark-MCQ is a multiple-choice benchmark designed to evaluate models' knowledge and reasoning about Earth-related topics (e.g., geography, remote sensing, environmental science) through curated MCQ items. It tests factual knowledge, interpretation of Earth science concepts, and potentially visual grounding if image evidence is included. The benchmark is intended to measure accuracy on domain-specific, short-answer selection tasks.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for Earth/remote-sensing knowledge with limited but growing usage among geoscience and remote-sensing ML researchers.
